topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I opened the package to find a beautifully crafted frame, holding a drawing from years ago. It was a simple scene of our classroom, yet there was a depth in the colors, a warmth in the lines that I had never fully appreciated before. Beneath the frame, a note read, "This class changed me. Thank you for believing in the power of what we do. - Alex." I ran my fingers over the drawing, remembering Alex, then a shy, uncertain kid, now sending a message across time. It’s moments like these that make the doubts, the long hours, all worthwhile. I’m eager to hang this up, not just as a decoration, but as a reminder of the unseen ripples we create in the lives of others.
